title: Networking & Infrastructure
description: Design, troubleshoot, and document networks the way a working IT technician does. Tests subnetting, VLAN planning, troubleshooting flows, and migration design.

seo.overviewBody: Reliable computer networks are the foundation of IT infrastructure. Network engineers are evaluated on IPv4/IPv6 CIDR subnetting, VLAN segmentation, switch and router configuration (Cisco/MikroTik), NAT rules, and VPN tunnel setup.

deliverables.title: 1. Network Topology & Subnet IP Plan
deliverables.desc: Network diagram specifying CIDR subnet boundaries, Gateway IPs, and VLAN IDs across corporate departments.

deliverables.title: 2. Switch & Router Configuration File
deliverables.desc: Production-ready CLI configuration script for managed switches establishing trunk ports, VLANs, and inter-VLAN routing.

deliverables.title: 3. VPN Tunnel & Latency Test Report
deliverables.desc: Site-to-Site IPsec/WireGuard VPN setup document and latency ping benchmark test log.

faqs.question: Why should corporate networks be segmented into VLANs?
faqs.answer: VLANs isolate network broadcast domains, improve security by preventing lateral movement, and optimize bandwidth by grouping departmental traffic.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a Site-to-Site VPN and a Remote Access VPN?
faqs.answer: Site-to-Site VPNs connect two static branch office networks together securely, while Remote Access VPNs connect individual remote user laptops to the corporate network.

faqs.question: How does NAT (Network Address Translation) work?
faqs.answer: NAT maps private internal IP addresses (e.g. 192.168.x.x) to a single public IP address when communicating across the internet.
